## Summary

Operator screenshot (04-06 '26): the Cuisine TMA recents drawer showed bare coordinate rows — `1.2722, 103.8113`, `1.4912, 103.7665` — meaningless to the user. *"the location are saved as coordinates which is meaningless to user, can you resolve this when save."*

**Root cause**: the `/api/cuisine/set-location` LRU write passed `label: opts.label || ''`. When the TMA POSTs coords-only (GPS auto-detect, map tap, "search this area"), the label is empty and the drawer falls back to rendering `<lat>, <lng>`.

**Fix** (`index.js`, the recents-LRU write): when no label is supplied, **reverse-geocode the coords → a human-readable place name** (`reverseGeocodeAddress`, already 24h-cached on a ~10m grid) before storing, with a **bare-country guard** (reject "Singapore"/"Malaysia" — `reverseGeocodeAddress` falls back to the country when no finer feature exists, which is just as meaningless). Also forward `country`/`region` so the drawer row shows the right flag instead of the generic 🌍 globe. Fire-and-forget IIFE so the HTTP 200 isn't delayed.

## Scope
- Only the TMA set-location write was affected. The other 5 `addRecentLocation` call sites (chat `/l`, `/location` free-text, OTHER picker, `/lrecent` re-tap) already pass a real label — verified, untouched.
- **Forward-only**: existing coordinate rows in a user's LRU re-resolve when re-anchored; no migration of stale rows.

## Verification
- `node --check index.js` clean.
- Individual vitest suites pass; the full-run failures observed were the known iCloud-stale-read pattern (transient corrupt reads under parallel workers), not real.
- Built + pushed via the GitHub Git Data API (local git push was hung on an incomplete object store from the squash-merge + iCloud — the commit/tree/blobs were created server-side; tree `3c547369` matches the local plumb build exactly).

## Test plan (post-merge)
1. Cuisine TMA → GPS auto-detect (no label) → wait ~30s → `/lr` shows a place name, not `1.27xx, 103.81xx`.
2. Map-tap / "search this area" → resolves to a name.
3. Named Place pick (VivoCity) → unchanged.
4. SG save shows 🇸🇬, JB save shows the JB/MY flag (not 🌍).

body:
## What

Operator tuned how `/hidden` decides a hidden gem:
- **New = opened ≤ 3 months** (was 4) — *"3 months or less are new"*
- **Rating floor 3.9** (was 4.0) — *"rating be 3.9 and above"*
- **Places review-time refute** of false "newly opened" claims (the only fabricable signal — Gemini infers the open date from the web; there is no opening-date field in any Places API).

## Why

`/hidden`'s C1 ("newly opened") is a Gemini web-grounded guess. A 300+-review venue can only pass the "300+ reviews UNLESS newly opened" exclusion via that C1 exception — so a hallucinated "new" claim lets a widely-known place through. A Google review can only be posted **after** a venue opens, so the **oldest** review Places returns is a sound one-directional check: it can *refute* newness (old review ⇒ not new), though it can't *confirm* it (Places returns ≤5 reviews).

## Changes

- **`gemini-client.js`** — C1 4→3 months + rating 4.0→3.9; C3 rating 4.0→3.9; EXCLUDE 300+-review exception 4→3 months and "below 4.0"→"below 3.9"; added a review-age refute nudge.
- **`hidden-verify.js`** — fetch `places.reviews` (rides the existing `places:searchText` call, no new request); `oldestReviewMonths()` + `stripOpeningClaim()` helpers; **drop** a 300+-review venue whose oldest review is >3 months old; **strip** false "opened …" wording from kept venues.
- **`package.json`** — 0.61.317 → 0.61.318.
- **Docs** — journal № 519 + serial-state counters/anchor.

## Tests

- `hidden-verify.test.js` **46/46** (9 new cases: `oldestReviewMonths`, `stripOpeningClaim`, refute drop/keep/strip).
- `hidden-gems.test.js` 46/46 (untouched — that's the cuisine pipeline filter, not `/hidden`).
- `node --check` clean on both changed `.js`.
- Full local suite is the known-flaky iCloud run (hangs / transient ERR_INVALID_PACKAGE_CONFIG); **CI is the authoritative full-green gate**.

## Scope note (intentional)

Legacy `surprise.js` (rollback path, `PIPELINE_TASKS_ENABLED=false`) and the cuisine pipeline's `hidden-gems.passesHardFilter` (floor 4.0) are **different surfaces** — not changed. Flagged in the journal.

## What changed

Make `/hidden` render the **same rich venue card** as `/search` free-text (`formatTechniqueVenueBlock`) — so copy / copy-to behave identically — **PLUS** a `📝 Latest review · <date>` line, and **DROP** the `💎 Why a gem` prose (the only fabricable field; the LLM can invent it).

Previously `/hidden` sent Gemini's chunked free text (rating + criteria + "Why a gem" prose), rewritten by `hidden-verify`. Now we stop sending Gemini's prose and build the proven shared card from the live Places fields the verifier already fetches.

### Per file
- **`hidden-verify.js`** — `FIELD_MASK` + `lookupVenue` return now carry card fields (`googleMapsUri`, `primaryType`/`primaryTypeDisplayName`, opening hours, `websiteUri`, phone, `priceLevel`, `editorialSummary`) — all ride the **existing** `places:searchText` verifier call (no new request). New `newestReviewIso()` helper (newest review `publishTime`), exported for tests. `oldestReviewMonths` + newness-refute unchanged.
- **`index.js`** — new `renderHiddenVenueCards()`: maps each verified venue to a `formatTechniqueVenueBlock`-shaped object (mirroring `searchVenuesByDish` keys), carries the Gemini-surfaced `🍲 Try ·` dish, best-effort `enrichTravelTimes` + `attachSocialsToVenues`, renders the shared card, then splices a `📝 Latest review · DD MMM YYYY` line right after the `🌟` rating line. Per-card try/catch. Both `/hidden` render paths (GPS `cached.lat/lng` + free-text geocoded `geo.lat/lng`) now call it instead of `chunkHiddenGemsOutput(verifiedText)`. Tier ladder, `allDropped → hidden.allClosed`, distance-rewrite, and the one-map button are all kept.
- **`i18n.js`** — `hidden.latestReviewLabel` (EN `📝 Latest review ·`, FR `📝 Dernier avis ·`).
- **`package.json`** — `0.61.318 → 0.61.319`.
- **`__tests__/hidden-verify.test.js`** — 4 `newestReviewIso` cases (newest-of-mixed, empty, unparseable-ignored, all-unparseable).
- **`doc/`** — journal #520 + `.serial-state.yml` (commit 533 / journal 520), re-anchored.

## Confirmation (built /hidden cards)
- (a) contain `📝 Latest review` — spliced after the rating line when a review date exists.
- (b) contain **no** `💎 Why a gem` — Gemini's prose is no longer sent.
- (c) reuse `formatTechniqueVenueBlock` — the exact `/search` formatter.

## Omitted fields (formatter skips absent → rows just don't render)

- `editorialSummary` is fetched but `formatTechniqueVenueBlock` has no row for it (currently unused; harmless).

## Gates

- `npx vitest run __tests__/hidden-verify.test.js __tests__/hidden-gems.test.js --no-file-parallelism --pool=forks --poolOptions.forks.singleFork` — **96/96** (hidden-verify 50/50 incl. 4 new; hidden-gems 46/46).

## Manual test (post-deploy, owner chat)

## Bugs (operator report — OTHER mode Country/City cascade)
1. **Map doesn't recentre** on a city pick.
2. **Stale free-text** shows "Johor Bahru".
3. **Second search silently no-ops** — no request, loading, or error.

## Root causes (verified, not assumed)
- **BUG 1 (fixed):** `MapPanel.syncMarkers` centres on the **venue centroid** when venues exist (`MapPanel.jsx:580-601`); falls back to `searchCenter` only when venues is empty. A city pick is `noAutoFire` → updates `searchCenter` but not `venues` → camera stays on the prior area.
- **BUG 2b (fixed):** `runSearch` opened with `if (!userLoc) return` (`App.jsx:1200`) — device GPS as the gate, the only silent exit. OTHER-mode location lives in `searchCenter`/`locationAnchor`, not `userLoc`.
- **BUG 2a (NOT fixed):** the editable field binds the **live** `locationAnchor.name` (updates on pick) and GPS auto-detect is one-shot (`autoDetectedRef`), so static code says the field should track the pick. body:
## The bug (live v0.61.328, Railway log as proof)

```
[menu/set-location] D776 ... text="legoland" region=SG → LEGOLAND Malaysia (1.4272,103.6295)
```

In the Menu TMA, typing **"legoland"** while the anchor region was **SG** resolved to **Legoland Malaysia** (Johor coords) but stored the anchor with `region: SG`. The Menu pill flag reads `anchor.region`, so it showed 🇸🇬 over a Malaysian address.

**Root cause:** the `/api/menu/set-location` **text** path only set `region` when *preserving* a cached JB/OTHER region — it never re-derived the region from the **resolved** coordinates. For an SG anchor that path never ran, so the response fell through to `region: setOpts.region || 'SG'`.

## The fix

The resolved point is the source of truth. After the geocode, derive region from `r.lat/r.lng`:

- `coarseGate` (SG centroid radius) → **SG**
- else Johor-extent bbox (`isJbCoords`) → **JB**
- else → **OTHER** (with `country` = `r.country` uppercased, else `MY` for the SG/MY-biased text geocode)

Radius cap preserved only when the **derived** region matches the cached region.

### Changed files
- **`location-mode.js`** — `isJbCoords` did not exist on main; added a pure coordinate-only Johor-extent gate (lat 1.20–2.55, lng 102.50–104.50) and exported it. Legoland `1.4272,103.6295` is inside → JB.
- **`index.js`** — `/api/menu/set-location` text branch re-derives `region`/`country` from resolved coords (replaces the `preserveRegion`-only logic). D776 log now shows `bias=` / `stored=`. OTHER (explicit country pick) and precinct branches untouched.
- **`package.json`** — `0.61.328 → 0.61.329`.
- **`doc/.serial-state.yml`** — commit 543 / journal 530 / build 329; re-anchored 13:05 SGT 06-06-26.
- **`doc/Journal/journal-0_61_329-06_06_26-1305.md`** — entry #530.

### Menu client
`web/menu/src/App.jsx:435` — `isMy = anchor && (anchor.region === 'JB' || anchor.region === 'MY-PUT' || anchor.region === 'OTHER')` is already driven by `anchor.region` and checks each disjunct correctly. With the server now storing `region='JB'`/`'OTHER'` for MY coords, `isMy` flips true → 🇲🇾. **No client change needed.**

### Gates
- `node --check index.js location-mode.js` → clean.
- `npm test -- --run` → **104/104 suites, 2892/2892 tests pass** (pipeline-task-gates also green this run).
- Trace: Legoland → `coarseGate` false, `isJbCoords` true → region `JB`, country `MY` → pill 🇲🇾. SG text picks unchanged (resolve inside `coarseGate` → SG).

## What & why

Unify the Michelin layer on a deterministic **per-city** schema so the curated SG list and the (future) regional lists share one shape. Additive only.

Unified per-entry schema:
`{ city, country, name, address, postal?, category, year, cuisine?, vegetarian, halal }`
— `category ∈ {three-star, two-star, one-star, bib-gourmand}`, `country` ISO-2, `year ∈ {2025, 2026}`.

## Guardrail honoured

**No Michelin venue data was generated, invented, scraped, or AI-fabricated for any city.** The 8 non-SG tables ship as **EMPTY arrays** for the Human Lead to fill by hand. The only data touched is the existing hand-curated `michelin-2025.js`, and only by **adding** three locality tags — no venue changed, removed, re-tiered, reordered, or added.

## Changes

- **`michelin-2025.js`** — stamps every curated SG entry **in place** (`SG_GROUPS` loop) with `city:'Singapore'`, `country:'SG'`, `year:2025`. **Venue literals + `module.exports` byte-unchanged** → `index.js`, `venue-templates.js`, `count-recount.js`, `healthier-eateries.js`, `michelin-walk.js` all consume it identically; the SG `/cuisine` "✳️ Michelin List" card renders the same 130 venues. (Diff: only the header comment + the additive loop — zero venue lines.)
- **`michelin/{my,th,vn,jp,kr,cn,hk,tw}.js`** (8 new) — EMPTY per-country tables `{ COUNTRY, ENTRIES: [] }` with the mandated curator header + a cities-hint comment. No pre-listed venues.
- **`michelin-data.js`** (new) — loader: merges SG + the empty tables into one **validated** pool; exposes `hasMichelinData(cityOrCountry)`, `michelinForCity`, `michelinForCountry`, `getAll`, `validateEntry`, `normalizeEntry`. `validateEntry` throws on a bad `category` / missing required field / non-ISO-2 country / bad year, so a future hand-curated row that breaks the contract fails fast at require-time. `vegetarian`/`halal` default to `false`.
- **Tests** — `michelin-2025.test.js` gains migration assertions (count 130 preserved; every entry now `Singapore/SG/2025`; originals byte-stable). New `michelin-data.test.js` covers the loader, the gate (`hasMichelinData('Singapore')===true`, `hasMichelinData('Tokyo')===false`), city/country filters, validation rejecting bad rows, and that every per-country table is empty.
- **`package.json`** — `0.61.329 → 0.61.330`. Journal + `doc/.serial-state.yml` bumped/re-anchored.

## Verification

- `node --check` on every changed/new `.js` → clean.
- `npm test -- --run` → **105 files / 2910 tests green** (full michelin-* suite included: michelin-2025, michelin-data, michelin-walk, michelin-narrate, michelin-cache, michelin-dedup-key).
- SG count **130 before === 130 after** (2 three-star + 7 two-star + 32 one-star + 89 Bib Gourmand).

## Live gating — deferred (by design)

The per-city gating (lighting the Michelin option only where `hasMichelinData`) is a **follow-up** once cities have rows. This PR exposes `hasMichelinData` so it's ready, but changes **no** live search/cuisine gating.

body:
## What

The SG Michelin listing (a) appeared not to start from 3★ and (b) showed no paging controls. A read-only trace proved **both** complaints trace to **one stale line**.

## Root cause

`michelinSummary.remaining` was hardcoded `0` in **v0.60.195** (when the seen-set walk was OFF) and **never updated when v0.60.198 RESTORED the walk**. So:

- The TMA's "📚 N more to explore — Tap 🔍 for next batch of 12" hint (gated on `michelinRemaining.remaining > 0`) **never appears**.
- With no page indicator, a re-tap **silently advances** the seen-set walk past the already-served 3★ slice → reads as "the list dropped the 3 stars".

The server order is actually correct (3★→2★→1★→shuffled Bib, no downstream re-sort) — page 1 of a fresh walk **does** start at 3★.

## Fix

`index.js` (`handleMichelinSearch`):

```js
remaining: exhausted ? 0 : Math.max(0, ordered.length - totalServedThisWalk),
```

- Honest remaining over the tier-ordered `ordered` pool the walk paginates.
- `0` when `exhausted` → the `<3-result` / walk-end recycle UX is unchanged.
- `michelinSummary` still ships on every response → the combo-`<12` autoReset suppression gate is preserved.

**Server-side only — no TMA build** (`App.jsx` already reads `remaining > 0`).

## Verification

- `node --check index.js` clean; `exhausted` / `ordered` / `totalServedThisWalk` all in scope at the return.
- `npx vitest run __tests__/michelin-data.test.js` → 36 green.
- Logical: fresh walk → `remaining = pool-12 > 0` (hint shows); walk end / `<3` → `remaining = 0` (hint hides).

## Files
- `index.js` — one expression + comment update
- `package.json` — `0.61.334 → 0.61.335`
- `doc/.serial-state.yml` — commit 548 / journal 535 / build 334 + re-anchor
- `doc/Journal/journal-0_61_335-06_06_26-1730.md` — new entry

## What

The Michelin result card showed paging **twice** — the v0.61.335 hint above the card *and* the header's "Showing first 12". This makes the hint the sole pager.

## Logic check (operator: "check your logic")

Michelin paginates **server-side**: each 🔍 tap fetches the next 12; the TMA only ever holds one 12-venue batch. So the client pager's `page` is **always 1** → the header always says "Showing first 12" **even on the server's 2nd/3rd batch**. The line isn't just redundant — it's **static and misleading**. The hint (driven by `michelinSummary.remaining`) is the accurate pager.

## Change — `web/cuisine/src/v2/components/ResultPanel.jsx`

- `const isMichelin = Number.isFinite(totalCount) && totalCount > 0;` — `totalCount` is passed **only** on Michelin responses, so this can't affect ordinary searches.
- For Michelin → `line2 = ''`; render guarded on truthiness.
- Michelin header now: `Results: 130` + `· Michelin Singapore 2025`, hint above as the pager.
- **Non-Michelin searches untouched** (they client-paginate, so "Showing A–B" stays correct).

## Verify

- `npm run build` (vite) clean — 79 modules. `public/cuisine` is gitignored; Railway rebuilds on postinstall.

## What

The Cuisine TMA **🆕 New** pill stops using the crude **≤150-review proxy** (v0.57.6) and adopts **`/hidden`'s review-time refute**.

## Decision (operator)

**Review-time refute, Places-only** — not the heavier LLM opening-date variant.

## How

A Google review can only post **after** a venue opens, so a review older than 3 months proves it's **not** newly opened. When `filters.newlyOpened` is on:
- Fetch each candidate's reviews via **Places Details** (reviews-only mask) — **gated on the pill**, so the extra cost applies only to New searches.
- Reuse `hidden-verify.oldestReviewMonths()` + the 3-month threshold; **drop** venues whose oldest review is > 3 months.
- **Keep** venues with no old review / no reviews (review-time can only *refute*, not confirm — Places returns ≤5 reviews).
- The "newly opened" query modifier still biases recall. Logs the before→after cut.

## Verify

- `node --check` clean; full suite **2986 green** (no test asserted the old ≤150 behaviour).
- Server-only (`index.js`) — no `web/` build; the pill UI is unchanged.

## Note
Refute ≠ confirm (the accepted tradeoff vs the LLM opening-date option). The `verifiedOpeningDate` the narrate pipeline already computes is not wired in — that'd be the "full /hidden" upgrade.

body:
## FX engine — PR 1 of 2

Operator added `ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY` for real FX rates because *"only in Malaysia that is rigid with fixed foreign currency exchange rate"*. The real cause was the **FX source**: the old Frankfurter-only path (ECB, ~33 majors) **omits TWD / VND / MOP / BND**, so those picker countries silently dropped the conversion. This PR replaces it with a **USD-pivot rate table**.

### What changed (`currency-format.js`)
- **`usdRate(cur, redis)`** (NEW) — USD per 1 unit. **Primary** Alpha Vantage `CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE` (`process.env.ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY`; rate-limit `Information`/`Note`/`Error Message` envelope → treated as a miss), **fallback** Frankfurter (`from=cur&to=USD`). `USD`→`1.0`. Cached **15 days** at `fx:usd:<CUR>` (`15*24*3600`) — satisfies *"once … 15 days"* and stays inside AV's 25-req/day free tier.
- **`fetchFxRate(a, b)`** (REWRITTEN) — `usdRate(a) / usdRate(b)`, a USD-pivot **cross-rate**. Fixes the rigid-currency gap: TWD/VND/MOP/BND now resolve via the pivot.
- **`convAmount()` + `FX_MARKUP=1.028` + `NO_CENTS`** — converted value gets a **+2.8 % markup, rounded UP** (whole for no-cents JPY/KRW/VND/IDR + ISO zero-decimal set, else 2 dp). Native menu price is never marked up.
- Parenthetical now reads **`(≈…)`** — e.g. `M$50–80 (≈S$14.91–23.85)`, `S$25–40 (≈US$19.02–30.43)`, `S$25–40 (≈¥2839–4542)`.

### Decisions (operator-confirmed)
1 = **Option B** (device currency) · 2 = **use USD** as base · 3 = **lazy** fetch; **markup 2.8 % round-up** + **"≈"**.

> **Scope:** this PR is the **engine**. It keeps the existing **location-based** `userCountry`. **Option B** (device currency from the TMA's `Intl` region → ~170-country map) is **PR 2**.

### Verification
- `node --check currency-format.js` clean.

## FX feature — PR 2 of 2 (Option B)

Builds on the v0.61.360 USD-pivot engine. The cross-border `(≈…)` conversion now lands in the user's **device home currency** (the phone's locale region) — what a traveller actually spends — instead of the location-based country.

### What changed
- **Client (`web/cuisine/src/v2/lib/api.js`)** — `deviceRegion()` derives the phone's home region (ISO-3166 alpha-2) **once** from `navigator.language` via `new Intl.Locale(lang).maximize().region` (`"en"`→`US`, `"en-SG"`→`SG`), fallback to the region substring (`"en-GB"`→`GB`). `postJson` injects `deviceRegion` into every request body.
- **Server (`currency-format.js`)** — `COUNTRY_TO_CURRENCY` expanded **~30 → ~170** ISO-3166→ISO-4217 entries (covers the picker neighbours MO/BN/KH/LA/MM the old ECB map omitted + the global long tail) + a dozen recognisable `CURRENCY_PREFIX` symbols; MO/BN added to `COUNTRY_PREFIX`. The long tail renders via the `"CODE "` fallback (e.g. `SEK 320`).
- **Server (`index.js`)** — `enrichPriceRangeDisplay(chatId, venues, deviceCountry)` **prefers** a valid `deviceCountry`, else falls back to `resolveUserCountry(chatId)`. Wired at `/api/cuisine/search` + inside `handleMichelinSearch`. Bot-chat flows (`safeSend`) stay on location fallback **by design** (no device there).

### Decision
**Option B** (operator-confirmed) — device home currency, not location-based country.

`startLocationSync`'s `onLocation` resolved the country with **`coordsToCountry()`** — a **SG/MY-only bounding box**. Outside SG/MY it returns `null`, so the Menu kept the **stale cached flag** as you moved. The global detector (`nearestIataCity` / `iata-snap`) ran **once on mount**, never during the follow. ## Fix — concurrent devices no longer clobber each other's location

Operator: *"i can have one telegram ChatID, but 5 devices (correct?) and each device's location set is different"* → chose **option 1** (per-device key).

### Confirmed real
Location was cached at `loc:<hash(chatId)>` and `country-pref:<chatId>` — **per-user, not per-device** — so concurrent devices shared one slot (last writer wins). The **live search was already correct** (each request carries its own `lat/lng`); only the persisted **seed** + OTHER-picker pref clobbered. (v0.61.362's sync country-pref write had *amplified* it.) Telegram `initData` has **no persistent device id**, so the TMA generates its own token.

### Fix
- **`device-id.js` (NEW, both TMAs)** — stable per-device token (`crypto.randomUUID`, `localStorage` `gia_device_id`, memoised), sent on every request.
- **`location-cache.js`** — `setUserLocation(…, opts.deviceId)` writes **both** the chatId-level key (bot-chat default + new-device seed) **and** `loc:<hash>:dev:<id>`; `getUserLocation(redis, chatId, deviceId)` reads per-device first, falls back to chatId-level.
- **`country-pref.js`** — `get`/`setUserCountryPref` gain `deviceId` with the same dual-write + read-fallback.
- **`index.js`** — `readDeviceId(req)` (body `deviceId` | `X-Device-Id` header | query) threaded into menu/cuisine `set-location`, `user-location`, `country-pref` GET/POST, and the cuisine `/search` cached-region read.
- **Clients** — Cuisine `postJson` (body) + `getJson` (header); Menu inline fetches.
- **Bot-chat** (no device) unchanged. The per-device read **falls back** to chatId-level, so absent/old clients behave exactly as before (safe failure mode).

### Verification
- `node --check index.js location-cache.js country-pref.js` clean.
- `npm run build` (menu + cuisine) clean.
- Full `npx vitest run` → **106 files / 3007 tests green** (+6: device isolation, seed fallback, chatId-level refresh).
- Version `0.61.362 → 0.61.363`, journal #563, serial-state bumped + re-anchored.

## PR 2 of 2 — the behavioural half

Operator: *"don't auto-load 5 cuisine's eateries if location is detected different … give 0.3 second pause to ensure it is resolved (solution should be actual street+building+city) and write to user's table of location then fire the auto-load."*

### Root cause (Image 1: "⏳ loading random eateries…" under the mismatch modal)
The splash-gate opener fired `runInitialLoad` the instant `userLoc` resolved. But the v0.61.274 coherence check depends on `state.countryPref`, which loads **async**. On the `userLoc`-resolved commit `countryPref` was often still `null` → the check returned early (no modal) → the gate opened + the boot load fired → **then** `countryPref` landed, the check re-ran, and the mismatch modal popped over the already-loading body.

### Fix (`web/cuisine/src/v2/App.jsx`, gate-opener)
- **0.3 s settle** — `setTimeout(…, 300)` before opening the gate, giving `countryPref` + the coherence checks a beat to raise a modal.
- **Re-check** — inside the timer, bail if `modalPendingRef` raised during the settle (effect re-runs on dismiss). `state.countryPref` added to deps so a late load restarts the timer.
- **Persist before load** — on the clean no-mismatch path, `reverseGeocode` the confirmed centre (→ street + building + city) and `saveUserLocation({lat, lng, label})` **before** `runInitialLoad`. Posts to `/api/cuisine/set-location` carrying the v0.61.363 **device token** (per-device slot); fire-and-forget so boot is never blocked (mirrors the `apply*` paths).

### Verification
- `npm run build` (cuisine) clean.
- Full `npx vitest run` → **106 files / 3007 tests green**.
- Version `0.61.364 → 0.61.365`, journal #565, serial-state bumped + re-anchored.

### Known limit
300 ms is a **fixed** settle (operator-specified "0.3 second"). If `countryPref` loads slower than 300 ms on a cold network, the modal can still pop late; a fully race-proof version would gate on a `countryPref`-loaded flag.

## "Fix the over-compress" — stage 1 (the highest-impact, tested, bounded piece)

The recurring "Other mode, still searching Singapore" bug class comes from the **search centre and the region being resolved separately**. `runSearch` (~:1600) and `runInitialLoad` (~:1451) each used `anchor || searchCenter || locationAnchor || userLoc` — the **device GPS was the unconditional last fallback even in OTHER/JB** — while the region came from `state.region`. So they could diverge: `region=OTHER`, `centre=SG device`.

### Fix — one region-coherent source of truth
- `web/cuisine/src/v2/lib/search-location.js` (NEW, pure) — `resolveSearchCenter({ region, anchor, searchCenter, locationAnchor, userLoc })`. Explicit picks win in every region; the device GPS is a valid centre **only** in SG. In **OTHER / JB / MY-PUT** it returns **null** — the centre can never silently be the device location.
- `__tests__/search-location.test.js` (NEW) — **12 cases**.

## Fix — GBP shown for a Singapore-Region phone

Operator (IMG_2322 + IMG_2323): a Japan venue's **¥10000** converted to **≈£47.79 (GBP)** while physically in Singapore. The phone has **Language = English (UK)** but **Region = Singapore** — the currency must follow the **Region** (→ S$).

### Root cause
v0.61.361's `deviceRegion()` read only **`navigator.language`** = the **Language** (`en-GB`) → maximized to **GB** → **GBP**. It never saw the iOS **Region** (Singapore). iOS encodes the Region as a Unicode **regional-override** `-u-…-rg-<cc>zzzz` in the **resolved** locale: `Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().locale` → `"en-GB-u-rg-sgzzzz"`.
(Gotcha: `new Intl.Locale("en-GB-u-rg-sgzzzz").region` still returns `GB` — the `rg` subtag must be string-parsed.)

### Fix
- `web/cuisine/src/v2/lib/device-region.js` (NEW, pure) — `regionFromUnicodeRg` + `regionFromLanguageTag` + `pickDeviceRegion` (**rg override wins**, else the language region).
- `__tests__/device-region.test.js` (NEW) — **10 cases**, incl. the operator's exact phone (`en-GB` + `rg-sg` → **SG**).
- `api.js` — `deviceRegion()` now feeds `[Intl.DateTimeFormat, Intl.NumberFormat].resolvedOptions().locale` + `navigator.language` into `pickDeviceRegion`.

### Verification
- `npm run build` (cuisine) clean.
- Full `npx vitest run` → **109 files / 3039 tests green** (+10).

A Seoul venue card (**종로은행나무집 시청점**) printed Gemini's **chat refusal** as its "Sanctuary read":

## Root cause (traced)
- `vibe-summary.js` `summarizeVibe()` returned the model's **raw text**, with no check it was the demanded two-line `🌿 Quiet / 🌿 Seating` shape.

## Why
Operator: *"first load cross 20 seconds threshold"* → *"first load just ask user to wait, **don't need fact card** — only subsequent results"* → *"keep to current display message and not use fact card"*.

## Root cause
The 20s **follow-device sync** (`location-sync.js`, `durationMs = 20000`) was gated only on `initialResolveDone` (location resolved), **not** on `firstLoadPending` (the actual boot venue fetch). So a slow first load that crossed the 20s window could be **re-centred / re-searched mid-flight** — and that re-search counts as **'rotating'**, which **pops a fact card** on the first load.

## Fix
- **`location-follow.js`** — `shouldFollowDevice` gains a `firstLoadPending` guard → the follow-sync **holds off** until the boot load lands.
- **`App.jsx`** — `firstLoadPendingRef` feeds the sync guard; plus a direct guard so the fun-fact modal can **never** show during the first load.

→ The first load shows **only** the "Please wait…" banner. Fact cards still appear on later searches.

## Verification
- Cuisine build green · full suite **113 files / 3094 tests** (+2 in `location-follow.test.js`).

## Bug

The **New** (newly-opened) filter returns **"no results"** in foreign-script OTHER countries — **Tokyo, Kyoto** (operator), and the Railway logs show the same in **Incheon / Seoul / Daejeon**. It worked in SG.

## Root cause (regression from v0.61.395 Track B)

Track B appends a local-language *"newly opened"* seed (`새로 오픈`, `新しくオープン`, …) as a **separate** recall query, so a bare New search has `cuisineQueries = ["newly opened", "<local>"]` (length 2).

`isMultiCuisine` was gated on **`cuisineQueries.length >= 2`** (`index.js:14443`), so that bare search was misread as a **2-cuisine AND-combo**:

- The combo phase joins the seeds with a **space** → `"newly opened 새로 오픈"` → Google **require-all** → recall collapses to ~6 mostly-old venues (`D702a "6 of 6"`).
- The combo validator uses `cuisineNames`, which is **empty** here → `[].every()` is **vacuously true** → the over-constrained set is accepted.
- The sound **3-month review-time refute** trims `6 → 1`; **nearby-widen** (≤20 km) drops the far-flung survivor `1 → 0` → **0 venues**.

`pipeline.discover` joins multiple cuisines with **` OR `** (`pipeline.js:1018`), so the **single** path would have produced `"newly opened OR 새로 오픈 cuisine restaurant"` = the broad recall Track B intended.

## Fix

```diff
- const isMultiCuisine = cuisineQueries.length >= 2;
+ const isMultiCuisine = cuisineNames.length >= 2;   // real picks, not inflated query count
```

The AND-combo's true intent is *"2+ real cuisines served together"*. A bare New search now routes through the single path → `discover` **OR-joins** the seeds → broad recall; the review-refute still decides newness soundly. `comboInfo.attempted` stays false for New (no spurious *"no exact combination"* banner). **Genuine 2+ cuisine fusion search is unchanged.**

## Verification

- `node --check index.js` clean. Full suite **113 files / 3097 tests** — **no regression**.
- **Server-only** → build counter holds (386). Railway redeploys on merge without a rebuild.
- Not unit-tested (inline express-route logic, no harness seam — same gap class as v0.61.396); verified by trace + the `pipeline.js:1018` OR-join invariant.

## Operator test

Set location **Tokyo / Kyoto** (and **Seoul**), tap **New** → genuinely newly-opened venues now load (was blank). SG New unchanged.

body:
## Urgent bug

With the **New** pill on in **Osaka / Tokyo**, **Fruits returns 0** — and the operator's log (`log/logs.1780910707621.json`) shows it's **every cuisine**, not just fruits.

## Root cause (from the operator's log, `index.js ~15084`)

Every logged search has `newlyOpened=true`. The **New** pill (since **v0.61.349**) uses `/hidden`'s **review-time refute** — drop any venue whose **oldest Google review is > 3 months** (a review can only exist after opening, so it *refutes* newness).

In an **established market** (Osaka) **every** candidate has reviews older than 3 months, so the **hard** cut zeroes the page:

```
cuisines=['fruits']   newlyOpened=true → discover 58 → fruit-label 28 → review-refute 28→0 → 0
cuisines=['american'] newlyOpened=true → review-refute 2→0 → 0
```

The `american` 2→0 confirms it's **general across cuisines** (answers *"poor results in other cuisines?"* → **yes**). Pre-v0.61.349 used a softer **≤150-review proxy** → *"last time I didn't have this issue."*

**Not** the durian-belt block (v0.61.397): the log shows fruits/durian on the **cuisine** path, no `D778-BLOCK`.

## Fix

Review-time can only **REFUTE**, never **CONFIRM**, newness — so it must **DEMOTE**, not **EMPTY**:

```diff
- venues = venues.filter((v) => v._oldestReviewMonths == null || v._oldestReviewMonths <= NEW_MAX_MONTHS);
+ const refuted = venues.filter((v) => v._oldestReviewMonths == null || v._oldestReviewMonths <= NEW_MAX_MONTHS);
+ venues = refuted.length ? refuted : preRefute;   // floor: never zero the page
```

When refuting would empty the list, keep the **"newly opened"-biased** recall pool. Markets with genuinely-new venues (**SG**) are **unchanged**.

## Verification

- `node --check index.js` clean. Full suite **113 files / 3097 tests** — **no regression**.
- **Server-only** → build counter holds (386). Railway redeploys on merge without a rebuild.

## Operator test

Osaka / Tokyo, **New** on, tap **Fruits** (or any cuisine) → a list loads (best-effort newest) instead of 0. SG New unchanged.

> Separate (not in scope): the Fruits/Durian **pill** is still belt-gated by v0.61.397. If you want the Fruits *pill* to work in Japan too, that's a one-line change — say the word.

## Urgent bug

The **recents drawer** (📍) shows **city-only / numeric / weird** labels and a generic 🌍 for non-SG/MY countries. Operator's long-standing spec: **street number + street/building name + city**, with the **country flag**.

## Root cause (`index.js`)

The TMA recents are written by **`/api/cuisine/set-location`** (`index.js:13430`). It stored only the **short** `reverseGeocodeAddress().name` (one feature → city/route/locality) and mapped the **flag for SG/MY only** (everything else → 🌍). `reverseGeocodeAddress` *already* fetches the full Geocoding **`formatted_address`** — it just wasn't used for the label, and it didn't expose the country's ISO-2 code.

## Fix

- **`reverseGeocodeAddress`** also returns **`countryCode`** = the country component's **`short_name`** (ISO-2). Cache key `v2 → v3`.
- **`recent-label.js`** (new) — **`tidyRecentLabel(geo)`** builds the label from `formatted_address`: drop the **trailing country** (the flag conveys it) + **postal noise** (standalone / leading-4-6 / trailing-3+), **prepend the POI / building name** when it adds detail. **Preserves 1–3 digit street numbers** (only 4–6-digit leading runs are postal).
  - `"Marina Bay Sands, 10 Bayfront Ave, Singapore"`
  - `"1 Chome-1-3 Marunouchi, Kita Ward, Osaka"`
  - `"176 Orchard Rd" → "Pavilion, 176 Orchard Rd"`
- The recents writer now **always** reverse-geocodes (24 h-cached on a ~10 m grid, fire-and-forget), **prefers** the full address over the client's short label/city pick, and stores **`geo.countryCode`** so the **flag renders for every country** (JP/KR/HK/…).

Uses the existing **Geocoding API** (`GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY`) — **no Address Validation call** (`formatted_address` already carries the street number + city; AV would be an extra paid call for standardisation we don't need).

## Note on "search result failure"

Recents labels are **display-only** — the search uses the stored **lat/lng** (precise, preserved when a recent is picked), so labels don't drive search. The JP **0-results** was the separate **v0.61.399** New-filter fix.

The anchor was pinned at **VivoCity, Singapore** (`1.2647,103.8232`) but **country-pref = MY** → region **OTHER** → `D703d OTHER country-text-filter cc=MY`. `country-text-match.filterVenuesByCountry` keeps only venues whose `area + name` text carries **Malaysia** keywords, so every **SG** venue fails:

```
durian   9 → 0
american 9 → 0
(no cuisine) 54 → 4   ← big pool leaks a few, hence "no filter works"

```diff
- venues = filterVenuesByCountry(venues, ctxCountry);
+ const filtered = filterVenuesByCountry(venues, ctxCountry);
+ // when the stale country-pref would EMPTY the page, keep the coord-pinned pool
+ if (filtered.length === 0 && beforeOther > 0) { /* FLOOR: keep venues */ }
+ else venues = filtered;
```

The quoted *"Your saved spot is {saved}, but you appear to be at {device}"* modal is the **anchorMismatch** one → `applyAnchorCoherenceChoice`. Today **both** choices immediately fire a search.

## Changes (`App.jsx` only — hang-prone gate, revert-ready)

## Investigation
There was **no 3.7 floor anywhere**. The main cuisine / `/s` / free-text searches used rating only for **ranking** + a `score < 40` drop; `/hidden` has its own **≥ 3.9** Gemini gate; the review *picker* uses > 3.8. - **Applied at 2 chokepoints** covering all surfaces:

  2. **`/api/cuisine/search`** — floors the **pool before pagination** (so `<3.7` never enters a page and top-N backfills).

The button '≥3.7' will change to the new rating … Create a '/rating' equal to '/r' … zero means anything from null … saved per chatid."*

**Confirmed semantics:** `no rating` = **unrated-only** (brand-new/unreviewed); `any rating` = **no minimum** (floor off); `≥3.7` / custom = that floor. Both the TMA custom field and `/rating` span **1.0–5.0**.

- **`venue-filters.js`** — `applyRatingFloor(venues, opts)` gains **`opts.mode`** (`floor` = the v0.61.425 guarded default, **unchanged** for legacy callers; `off`/`any` = keep all; `unrated` = keep only unrated, still never empties).

**Chat:** `/rating` → shows current; `/rating 0` → any; `/rating 4.3` → floor; `/rating xyz` → suggests 3.7. Set on one surface, confirm the other reflects it.

Cause: the 20 s "follow my device" sync overrode your KL pick; its name-based guard missed because the inherited pick had **no anchor name**.

**Michelin greyed for MY (confirmed):** log `23:25:26` → `OTHER-region: **no country-pref**`. The drawer reads `currentMichCountry = countryPref || ''` → empty → not in the Michelin country list → chip greyed. But MY has Michelin (KL 33 + Penang 37). Jakarta greys correctly (no Indonesian guide).

You chose **"Explicit pick wins."**

- **`App.jsx`** — `explicitPickRef` + a region-keyed effect: whenever you're in a chosen foreign region (OTHER/JB), (a) **lock device-follow off** so the SG GPS can't drag you back, and (b) **backfill `countryPref`** from the committed coords when empty (`coordsToCountry → MY`, else nearest IATA city) + persist it — which **re-enables the Michelin chip** and scopes the country filter. Only fills when empty (never overrides your pick). Device-follow still runs on a plain GPS start.

body:
## What broke

Searching for a Singaporean dish while your country is set to **Malaysia, Indonesia, or Thailand** (or any non-SG anchor like a Bangkok/Tokyo pin) returned *"Sorry, no Singapore venues found…"* — even though Google Maps clearly lists e.g. Singaporean restaurants in Bangkok.

This affects **any** nation, not just Singapore: it's the same bug for Indonesian food in Vietnam, Malaysian food in Japan, etc. — whenever the typed dish is a curated `NATION_OVERLAY` iconic entry.

## Root cause

`runNationIconicFanOut()` (the rich-card fan-out for iconic dishes like `chilli crab`, `kaya toast`, `milo dinosaur`) was the one search path the v0.61.230 "region-aware search" work missed. It:

1. **Injected the literal word "Singapore"** into the Google Places `textQuery`.
2. **Never passed `regionCode`** to `searchVenuesByDish()`, so it fell back to the `'SG'` default.
3. **Hardcoded the "no Singapore venues" error copy.**

So even though the `locationBias` circle was correctly set to the user's location (Bangkok), the query text said *"Singapore"* and the region code forced *SG* — Places got contradictory geo signals and returned nothing. Google Maps, by contrast, searches "Singaporean food near Bangkok" with no SG lock and finds the restaurants.

`runCookingMethodFanOut()` had an adjacent half-fix: it built the region-aware query suffix but still forgot to forward `regionCode` to its inner Places call.

The generic *cuisine* path (picking "Singaporean" in the Cuisine Mini-App) was already region-correct and is unaffected.

## The fix (per file)

- **`region-code.js`** (new): extract `resolveRegionCode(loc)` — single source of truth for the Places `regionCode` (ISO alpha-2 country wins; legacy `JB`/`MY-PUT` → `MY`; default `SG`). Replaces the inline copies that `handleSearchTurn` and the cooking-method callback grew independently.
- **`index.js` — `runNationIconicFanOut`**: add `regionCode` param, drop the literal "Singapore" suffix when abroad (`regionCode !== 'SG'`), forward `regionCode` to `searchVenuesByDish`, and make the no-results copy region-neutral. Pass `regionCode` at both call sites (`/s` flow and the free-text path).
- **`index.js` — `runCookingMethodFanOut`**: forward the already-resolved `regionCode` to its inner `searchVenuesByDish` and de-hardcode its no-results copy.
- **`__tests__/region-code.test.js`** (new): unit tests for `resolveRegionCode`.
- **`package.json`**: version bump `0.61.429` → `0.61.430`.

## Verification

- `node --check` clean on all changed `.js`.
- `npm test` — **3173/3173 green** (incl. the 5 new `region-code` tests).
- `/gia-preflight` checklist walked: no-results branch still sends, `esc()` preserved on all user/Places fields, no unescaped HTML interpolation, `textQuery` is not Telegram-rendered.

## Manual test plan (post-deploy)

1. Set location/country to **Bangkok / Thailand**, then:
   - `/s chilli crab`
   - `/s kaya toast`
   - free-text: `milo dinosaur`
   - → expect Bangkok-area Singaporean venues instead of zero results.
2. Repeat with an **Indonesian** dish while anchored in **Vietnam**, and a **Malaysian** dish while anchored in **Japan** — expect local results.
3. Regression check: anchor back to **Singapore**, repeat the SG dishes — expect unchanged SG results.

body:
## What broke

Picking **Singapore** (the SG region pill) + **Michelin** could return a **wrong-country** Michelin list (e.g. Malaysia/Vietnam venues) instead of Singapore's.

## Root cause

The latest Michelin PR, **#949 (v0.61.432)** — "Michelin abroad: country resolution + country-wide primary + cuisine pinned to top" — rewrote the `michelinCountry` resolution at the single `handleMichelinSearch` caller (`index.js`):

```js
} else if (isOther) {                       // region === 'OTHER' || 'MY-PUT'
  michelinCountry = requestCountry || null; // explicit body countryCode
  if (!michelinCountry && csChatId) {
    const cachedLoc = await getUserLocation(...);
    const lc = cachedLoc?.country?.toUpperCase();
    if (/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(lc) && lc !== 'SG') michelinCountry = lc;  // ← stale foreign country
  }
} else { michelinCountry = 'SG'; }
```

- The **clean SG-pill path is correct** (`region:'SG'` → `else` → `'SG'`).
- But when an SG-intended search reaches the server as **`region=OTHER`** (region drift / stale app state) **without `countryCode:'SG'`**, #949's new fallback reads the **cached `location.country`** — which, after testing MY/VN, is `MY`/`VN` → **foreign Michelin despite picking Singapore**. (Pre-#949 the same drift leaked to the *SG* list, which accidentally matched SG intent; #949 removed that SG fallback to fix MY/VN abroad — turning accidental-SG into accidental-foreign-or-empty.)

The resolution never consulted the **anchor coordinates**, which were inside Singapore the whole time.

## The fix

`index.js` (single `handleMichelinSearch` caller): add an **`insideSG` guard** *before* the `isOther` branch — when the search anchor is physically inside the SG bbox (`insideSG`, already computed upstream), force `michelinCountry = 'SG'`, regardless of a drifted region or a stale cached country.

- Picking a foreign **guide-city** sets foreign coordinates (`insideSG=false`), so browsing Michelin abroad is **unaffected**.
- `isJB` still bails to `null` first (no JB list); the `OTHER` / `else` branches are otherwise unchanged.

This makes the **in-Singapore anchor authoritative** so the symptom can't surface regardless of client-side region/country drift.

## Verification

- `node --check index.js` clean; single `handleMichelinSearch` caller confirmed.
- Full suite **3175/3175 green**. Server-only change → no `web/` build.
- Clean `region:'SG'` searches already returned `'SG'`, so no regression for in-SG; abroad branches byte-identical.

## Manual test plan (post-deploy)

1. With a prior **MY/VN** pick still cached, pick **Singapore** (SG pill) + **Michelin** → expect the **Singapore** Michelin/Bib list (not foreign).
2. Pick **Malaysia** / **Vietnam** guide cities + Michelin → still the **MY/VN** national list (unchanged).
3. From a phone physically in SG, browse a foreign guide-city + Michelin → still returns that foreign list (the picker sets foreign coords).

## Note

The deeper question — *why the SG pill sometimes reaches the server as `region=OTHER`* — is a client-side state-drift issue (App.jsx region reset + the 20s device-follow, partially addressed by v0.61.430). This server guard makes the anchor authoritative so the symptom is neutralised regardless; a follow-up could still tighten the App.jsx region reset.

title: v0.62.31: hardening from the adversarial review of the last 8 PRs
body:
Operator: *"see the last 8 PR — can you do it better, explain."* Adversarial self-review of #978–#993 (every claim re-verified against code) found **3 confirmed defects + 4 weaknesses in my own shipped work**. This PR fixes them.

## A — HIGH: my #978 deadline burned the seen-set
When D706 fired, the user got an **empty** degraded-200 — but the body kept running and marked the **never-shown venues as seen** → the next tap silently skipped them. Now: `_deadlineFired` (set **after** the headersSent bail → streaming untouched) skips the seen-set + session-page writes, and `_gatheredRef` returns the **fast-enriched page** in the degraded response instead of `[]`. The 30s cache stays on = correct re-tap recovery.

## B — MED: D787 server-side label guard
The v0.62.30 latch was client-only. `setUserLocation` now refuses an **`ambient`** write (only the 20s follow-sync sends it) over a fresh **labelled** pick → `{kept:true}`. Chat share-pins / 📍 / `/location` unchanged (no flag → full overwrite).

## C — MED: honest border ratio
38% computed **2.97:1** vs the card (under the claimed ~3:1) → **42%** = 3.39:1 vs card / 3.85:1 vs bg, all 5 TMAs; comment states the computed numbers.

## D — MED: CJK Try-line verification
`DISH_ALIASES` (japanese 24 / chinese 9 / cantonese 8 / sichuan 6 — **every key invariant-tested** to exist in the unshared iconic list) + a **script-aware needle floor** (CJK ≥2 — the flat ≥4 would have skipped ALL CJK aliases). 味噌ラーメン / 天ぷら / 餃子 / 麻婆豆腐 / 叉燒 now verify.

## E + F
Menu **far-from-pick hint** (>50 km, dismissible, never auto-moves — operator's "hint, never auto") · memoized chip-name Map + Michelin chip edition-label parity.

**Process:** the adversarial review now runs on my own diff **before** merge (done for this PR — stream-safe flag ordering + both clearTimeout exits verified).

title: v0.62.33: Arrival Plate — wipe card synchronously on city switch + visibility-refresh plate sync
body:
## What

Fixes the operator's deployed-surface report on v0.62.32: *"i switch from putrajaya to Hanoi, the what to try here is still the old dishes … the card should be wipe clean."*

## Root cause (two holes)

1. **`App.jsx` visibility-refresh (v0.61.186 `refetchAndFlip`)** — synced anchor/region/countryPref/precinctId from `/api/cuisine/user-location` but never `arrivalPlate`. A switch learned on visibility restore (chat `/location`, Menu TMA, or a missed persist response) kept the old card forever.
2. **`onLocationSelect`** — the plate was wiped only in the persist response's `.then`. A failed persist (or the cityPreview 350 ms debounce dying when the webview backgrounds) left the stale card — which also reads as "the city didn't save".

## Fix

- `setArrivalPlate(null)` **synchronously** on every finite-coords pick — card wipes the moment you pick; the persist response re-fills it for curated cities. Failed persist now shows **empty (honest)**, never stale.
- `setArrivalPlate(r.plate || null)` on the visibility-refresh path (mirrors tryServerCache).
- Boot gate / reconciliation policy / persist debounce untouched.

## Verification

Full suite 3386/3386 green (132 files); `build:cuisine` green. Two additive state-sync calls, App.jsx only.

## Manual test plan (deployed)

1. Putrajaya → switch to Hanoi → card disappears **immediately** on the pick.
2. Switch city via chat /location or Menu TMA, return to Cuisine TMA → card updates/clears on the visibility flip.
3. Sapporo → Hanoi → Sapporo: card wipes, then returns with Sapporo dishes.

**[UNVERIFIED]**: the "didn't save" half — every pick path traces to a persist in code; if Hanoi still doesn't stick after this deploy, a Railway log paste around the switch pins whether `[set-location]` ever arrived.

title: v0.62.34: D791 post-search location consistency check — re-push the committed pick when the server label drifts
body:
## What

Operator (VN>HCM screenshot): *"After the result is displayed, should check if location is still set to the location. Here i set to VN>HCM, the results are correct but it switch to hanoi (capital)."* Fix shape **1** chosen by the operator from the 3 offered.

## Root cause

The v0.61.186 visibility re-fetch (`refetchAndFlip`) runs on `viewportChanged` — Telegram fires it even on keyboard open/close — and overwrites the client anchor with the server cache **without the explicit-pick latch** (the follow-GPS sync respects `explicitPickRef`; this path never did). When the pick's set-location was lost or out-raced, the stale server label (Hanoi, from the capital auto-commit) was pulled over the fresh HCM pick.

## Fix

New `reassertPickAfterSearch(snap)` in `App.jsx`, called at the end of both result paths (`runSearch` + `handleNLSubmit`):
- Gated on `explicitPickRef` + a named finite-coords anchor — plain GPS sessions untouched.
- `fetchUserLocation()` → server label ≠ pick name → **silent re-push** (`saveUserLocation` with label/region/country/radiusCapM, **no notify** — no chat spam, no map move).
- Arrival Plate syncs from the re-push response. `D791` console line. Fire-and-forget.

Options 2 (latch the visibility re-fetch) and 3 deliberately not taken — operator chose 1. Known edge (in journal): a chat/Menu pick made between a TMA pick and the next search is overwritten by the re-assert — consistent with the v0.61.430 "explicit pick wins this session" policy.

## Verification

Full suite 3386/3386 green (132 files); `build:cuisine` green.

## Manual test plan (deployed)

1. VN → HCM → 🔍 → after results the city pill **stays HCM**; relaunch comes back to HCM (console shows `D791 … re-pushing` if the server had drifted).
2. Plain SG GPS session: no D791, nothing re-pushed.

title: v0.62.35: boot auto-detect respects labelled picks — kill the bare label-wiping set-location write
body:
## What

The operator's Railway log pinned the long-suspected first-load corruptor: three bare `[set-location] chat=… → 1.2722,103.8112` writes (label-less, region-less SG device coords) each **replacing** the labelled `"Ho Chi Minh City" VN OTHER` pick — `location-cache.setUserLocation` replaces the whole payload, never merges.

**Writer**: the v0.61.242 boot **auto-detect** effect — step 5 persisted bare `{lat,lng}` and ran on every boot once userLoc resolved (only deep-link boots skipped it). The corrupted coords-only cache then booted incoherently: coords adopted, no label → no anchor/latch, no region → SG-default 🇸🇬 flag, MY cascade defaulting to capital KL, plus an unlatched random-places auto-load — exactly the operator's screenshot.

## Fix (extends v0.62.30's "a LABELLED cached location is an explicit pick on EVERY boot path" — no policy reversal)

- **A** — auto-detect **early-returns** when the explicit-pick latch + a named anchor hold: no GPS prompt, no Gemini iata-snap, **no persist**. Boot load still fires at the cached anchor.
- **B** — when it legitimately runs (no pick), its persist now carries **`ambient: true`** (D787 refuses it over a fresh labelled pick — also closes the initData-boot race where it fired before the latch armed) **+ label/region/country** — the cache can never be bare coords-only again.
- **C** — `tryServerCache` derives the region from coords (coordsToCountry → isJbCoords → nearestIataCity, mirroring the follow-sync) when a legacy coords-only cache has no region.

## Verification

Full suite 3386/3386 green (132 files); `build:cuisine` green.

## Manual test plan (deployed)

1. Set HCM → relaunch from SG → console: `auto-detect: SKIPPED — labelled cached pick "Ho Chi Minh City" holds`; pill stays HCM; Railway shows **no** bare `→ 1.27,103.81` line.
2. Clear the pick (×) → plain GPS boot: auto-detect runs; its `[set-location]` line now carries `label=… region=…`.
3. A legacy coords-only foreign cache boots with Others+country — never a 🇸🇬 flag.

title: v0.62.44: URGENT TMA auth guard (open-from-Telegram screen) + cuisine "What to order" plate Phase 1
body:
## ⚠️ Urgent: TMA auth guard (v0.62.44) — the headline of this PR

**Symptom:** a real iPhone hit `[twa-auth] 401` on **every** TMA mount call (`/catalogue`, `/session/start`, `/search`, `/user-location`, …) → blank app + a 401 storm in the logs.

**Diagnosis (read-only — not a server regression):**
- `twa-auth.js` (HMAC + 24h expiry) is **unchanged since v0.61.393**; no recent PR touched the gate (`app.use(&#39;/api/cuisine&#39;, requireInitDataFromBodyOrHeader)`).
- **One IP** failing **every** call ⇒ that client sent **empty or expired `initData`** (opened outside Telegram, or a stale &gt;24h launch). A bad bot token would 401 **all** users, not one. **The 401s are correct security behaviour.**

**Fix = client resilience, NOT weakening auth:**
- `tg.js` → `hasInitData()`.
- `api.js` → `httpErr()` tags 401 responses with `code:&#39;AUTH&#39;`.
- `App.jsx` → `authBlocked` state: the catalogue boot sets it on `!hasInitData()` (and **skips the doomed mount calls → stops the 401 storm**) or on an `AUTH` error; a top-of-render early return shows a clear **EN/FR &#34;Open Soleat from Telegram&#34;** screen with a reload button.
- **Server `twa-auth.js` is untouched** — auth still fully enforced. No `SKIP_INIT_DATA_AUTH`, no ungating `/catalogue`.

**Immediate unblock (no deploy needed):** reopen the Mini App from the **bot&#39;s menu button** (or `/start` → tap the button) so Telegram regenerates a fresh signed `initData`.

&gt; If 401s ever appear across **many** IPs at once, that&#39;s a different root cause (token/env break) — this guard doesn&#39;t mask it (server still 401s; client just shows the screen).

---

## Also in this PR: cuisine &#34;What to order&#34; plate — Phase 1 (v0.62.43)

(Built immediately before the urgent fix; bundled because the session is constrained to one branch.)

Operator: *select Georgian in SG → show the unique Georgian dishes to order before picking an eatery.* **With results · cuisine replaces the geo city plate · grouped by food group (3 headliners, then ascending-size sections).**

- **`dish-food-group.js`** (new, pure) — `foodGroupFor()` classifier (drinks via NATION_OVERLAY `kind`, per-dish overrides, keyword rules, `other` fallback) + `groupCuisineDishes()` → `{headliners, groups asc}`. 12-group taxonomy.
- **`index.js`** — `/api/cuisine/search` attaches `payload.cuisinePlate` from the selected cuisine&#39;s `nation-overlay` dishes when a single cuisine is set (pure in-memory, no Places spend).
- **`ArrivalPlate.jsx`** — `plate.mode===&#39;cuisine&#39;` branch (header + explainer + &#34;few spots here&#34; + headliner rows + food-group chip sections).
- **`App.jsx`** — `cuisinePlate` state; renders `cuisinePlate || arrivalPlate`.

Phase 2 (curation): per-dish history + native-script names → per-dish 📜 fact cards.

body:
## What&#39;s in this PR

### 1. Rating filter rework + the &#34;Unrated shows rated venues&#34; bug (v0.62.54)
- **`venue-filters.js` `applyRatingFloor(&#39;unrated&#39;)` — BUGFIX.** It used to also keep barely-reviewed venues that *show* a star rating (`&lt;10` reviews) **and** fall back to the entire rated list when nothing was unrated → rated restaurants leaked into &#34;Unrated&#34; (operator: *&#34;I select &#39;no ratings&#39; but two restaurants with ratings appear&#34;*). Now strict: **any star rating &gt; 0 is excluded**, and an empty result stays empty (no fallback). Removed the now-unused `UNRATED_MODE_MAX_REVIEWS`.
- **`QuickFilters.jsx`** — four **stacked** options matching the spec:
  - ○ **Unrated** — *New or no reviews yet* (italic, small)
  - ○ **Any rating** — *No minimum* (italic, small)
  - ○ **Good+** ≥ 3.7
  - ○ **Set rating** — `[Choose 1.0 to 5.0]` field box

fix(geo): tight 15km cap for Putrajaya/Cyberjaya — stop Klang Valley drift to KL (v0.62.68)
body:
## What &amp; why

Closes the location-drift surfaced in the operator&#39;s Railway log (`log/logs.1781315803421.json`, 12-06 &#39;26, `chat 313940231`):

```
[LocDrift] set-location  label:&#34;Putrajaya&#34;  cap_m:null
[LocDrift] search-anchor  center:[2.96957,101.71218] radius_m:20000 cap_m:45000 cap_src:&#34;city-default&#34;
[Cuisine-Search] D703d OTHER-scope … (≤45000m of set location)
```

The anchor was correct (Putrajaya, stable to 3 m) — but a Putrajaya pick persists **no** `radiusCapM`, so the search fell back to the **MAJOR 45 km** `city-default`. **Putrajaya + Cyberjaya are a compact cluster ~20 km *south* of the KL core**, so a 45 km cap from a Putrajaya pin reaches central KL (22.6 km), Petaling Jaya (20.9 km) and Shah Alam (22.8 km) — the &#34;drift to KL.&#34;

## The fix

New **`TIGHT_15KM`** tier in `city-centroids.js` for `Putrajaya` + `Cyberjaya`. 15 km keeps the Putrajaya–Cyberjaya cluster (Cyberjaya is 2.5 km away) while excluding the KL core. It&#39;s the **city-default fill only** — a deliberately picked `radiusCapM` still wins (the `index.js` anchor-cap block is untouched), and `searchRadius` is not mutated.

| Tier | Radius | Members |
|------|--------|---------|
| **TIGHT** (new) | 15 km | Putrajaya, Cyberjaya |
| DENSE | 30 km | Singapore, Johor Bahru, Iskandar Puteri, Batam |
| MAJOR | 45 km | default (KL, Bangkok, …) |
| SPARSE | 60 km | island / resort / secondary towns |

## Tests
- New tier assertion + the **exact logged drift pin** `(2.96957, 101.71218)` now caps at 15 km (regression guard).
- Allowed-radius set updated to include 15 km.
- Full suite green: **3448 passed**.

## Out of scope (noted, not in this PR)
- **AI-credit depletion** (Gemini 429 / Anthropic 400 in the same log) — operator action; reported separately. Top-ups confirmed done.

title: docs: Soleat 2-page primer (public/doc/soleat-about.html)
body: Adds the Soleat 2-page primer as a self-contained HTML page at public/doc/soleat-about.html. A feature tree rooted at /, grounded in the real setMyCommands + bot.onText surface; an Observe/Interpret/Act loop with a Wisdom apex; print-styled to two A4 pages; served at /doc/soleat-about.html. Static doc asset, no app code -> no version bump.

title: fix(cuisine): venue pin tap stays in the TMA, no jump to Google Maps (v0.62.114)
body: Tapping a Google Maps venue pin inside the Cuisine TMA jumped OUT to the Google Maps app. Root cause: the marker click handler branched on touch detection - non-touch -> openInGoogleMaps(v). So Telegram Desktop left the Mini App. Fix: the pin click now always opens the in-app InfoWindow preview + on-tap transit; Google Maps stays reachable via the Google Map CTA.

title: docs: UI consistency audit + skeuomorphism verdict (public/doc/soleat-ui-audit.html)
body: Materialises the UI consistency audit as a self-contained HTML report at public/doc/soleat-ui-audit.html. Verdict: foundation consistent, surface fragmented; skeuomorphic? No (flat-first + a small named accent set, because Telegram Mini Apps must stay theme-adaptive). Ranked inconsistencies + the rule to adopt. Static doc asset, no app code -> no version bump.

title: feat: result-card / pin tap zooms map to 17, tap-out restores prior zoom (cuisine + hawker, v0.62.115)
body: Cuisine result-card tap -> setZoom(17) alongside pan + blink (flashPin) + popup. Hawker pin tap -> pan + setZoom(17) + info window + on-tap transit. Both: a tap on the empty map / card X (closeInfo) restores the prior browsing zoom (captured once per focus burst into prevFocusZoomRef). Cuisine pin taps stay zoom-free.

title: feat(cuisine): "Local food picks" plate - 3-stage collapse + qualifier-led one-liner (v0.62.116)
body: Reworks the geo What-to-try-here plate: renamed to Local food picks (FR Selection locale); collapsed by default with a two-staged expand (0 label -> 1 peek one-line A-B-C -> 2 full dish rows). leadWithQualifier() reformats the peek: Laksa (Katong) -> Katong Laksa, Bak Kut Teh (Teochew) -> Teochew Bak Kut Teh. Display-only; d.dish stays the search query.

title: feat: venue type line uses specific cuisine from places.types[], hides if generic (v0.62.117)
body: Google Maps showed The Butcher's Wife as a Gluten-free restaurant but the TMA showed generic Restaurant. The specific subtype lives in places.types[], never requested. humaniseRestaurantType now resolves localized primaryTypeDisplayName -> most specific *_restaurant from types[] -> raw primaryType -> nothing (hide the line when only a bare Restaurant/Food).

title: fix: GPS reverse-geocode resolves to building/street, not the planning area (v0.62.118)
body: A shared GPS location showed the pill Bukit Merah (planning subzone) when Google Maps shows 115 Bukit Merah View. reverseGeocodeAddress put route below neighborhood/sublocality, contradicting its own comment. Fix: prefer building (POI/premise/establishment) then street/route over area names; planning-area names are now the fallback. Used by /location and /transport.

title: fix(transport): correct wrong Bukit Panjang LRT station coordinates (v0.62.119)
body: BP LRT station pins sat at the wrong locations (the line read correctly). Five BP stations (Keat Hong BP3, Teck Whye BP4, Phoenix BP5, Petir BP7, Bangkit BP9) had coordinates well outside tolerance - plotted in the northern loop instead of the southern arc. Corrected to LTA-authoritative centroids from the MasterPlan2019 RailStation geojson in data/mrt-coords.json + data/stations.json. Data-only, no rebuild.

title: docs: "Local food picks" rework MVP mockup (global-first + Bib near here + SG hawker choice)
body: A visual MVP mockup (not a build) of the reworked Local food picks plate: global-first curated city picks (Tokyo gets Tokyo dishes); keep the Bib Gourmand near-here curation; flag 2-3 nearby hawker centres as a choice (Singapore mode only). Shows SG (Bukit Merah) and Tokyo side-by-side. Static doc artifact, no version bump. At /doc/soleat-local-food-picks-mvp.html.

title: docs: Hawker mini-app rework MVP mockup (per-centre detail + Bib stalls)
body: A visual MVP mockup (not built) of a Hawker mini-app rework - the per-centre detail view that the Local food picks hawker-centre layer would deep-link into. Shows the gap today (no per-centre page), the flow (tap centre -> open Hawker focused on it), and a proposed per-centre detail view (ABC Brickworks: stalls, tags, Bib stalls inside, transit). Static doc, no version bump.

title: feat(cuisine): bus-stop codes in the venue card are hyperlinks too (v0.62.120)
body: The eatery card's transit block linked train stations but showed bus-stop codes as plain text. Now they are hyperlinks too. New controller method focusBusStop(code): pans + flashes the stop on this map and opens its live-arrivals popup (openBusInfo) - parity with the station-code link, staying in the TMA. transitBlockHtml renders each bus code as a link -> window.__giaFocusBusStop.

title: fix(cuisine): SG search no longer drifts to foreign venues (Polish -> Poland) (v0.62.121)
body: Selecting Polish with a Singapore set location returned actual Warsaw restaurants at the list tail (D703s SG-scope 60 -> 60, dropped nothing). The SG branch of scopeVenuesByRegion used withinCap, which keeps any venue whose distanceM is null - a coordless far Places match slipped through. Fix (SG branch only): coordless kept only if empty/Singapore address; never-empty floor draws only from finite-distance within 120 km.

title: feat(cuisine): cuisine plate - "Cuisine:" label, 3-stage collapse, non-cuisine exclusion (v0.62.123)
body: Cuisine What-to-order plate: relabel What to order in {X} (X is a cuisine, not a place) -> Cuisine: {flag}{X}; the 3-stage collapse (added to the GEO plate in v0.62.116) is now wired to the cuisine branch (cuisineStage 0 label -> 1 peek -> 2 full); NON_CUISINE_PLATE set so michelin/bib-gourmand/fusion (category chips, not cuisines) never build a Cuisine: plate. Follow-up: multi-cuisine -> one section each.

The diff had already landed via #1071 (384b6ae); this squash commit carries no net file change vs its parent. Recorded for ledger completeness.

title: docs: Eatery Card redesign + music-app carousel MVP mockup
body: The Eatery Card redesign + music-app carousel mockup. Shows card collapsed vs expanded (collapse boundary at address-onward), the full row re-order annotated old->new (price/pet above address, review near end, vibe after review, buttons last), and the music-app carousel (selected card centred over a half-height map, neighbours peek left/right, tap-out -> list). Static doc, no version bump.

title: feat(cuisine): result card - re-order rows + collapse (Try stays visible) (v0.62.124)
body: Mockup-approved restructure of the Eatery Card. Always visible (collapsed): name, restaurant type, meta (star/$/open/distance), price/access/pet/crowd, Try. Collapsible in new order: address -> Recommend -> Michelin/Bib -> Healthier/building -> review -> vibe -> Maps/Copy/socials (last). A details/less toggle (stops propagation); the focused card auto-expands (reused by the carousel).

title: feat(cuisine): music-app result carousel over the map (v0.62.125)
body: When a result card is selected, the list becomes a horizontal swipe-carousel floating over the lower map: picked card centred + auto-expanded, neighbours peeking; map recenters/zoom-17/blinks (v0.62.115 wiring); X or empty-map tap -> back to the list. New ResultCarousel.jsx as an absolute overlay docked as a MapPanel child (the vertical ResultPanel below is untouched). Lowest-risk overlay approach.

title: feat(cuisine): equal-width region pills + skeuomorphic selected pill in dark mode (v0.62.126)
body: Region picker (Current/Singapore/Johor Bahru/Cities): 1) Equal-width pills - JB hogged the slack (flex-1 vs content-width); all four are now flex-1 basis-0 px-1, equal width. 2) Skeuomorphic selected state in dark mode - the selected pill gets .glass-pill--selected (pressed-in/debossed accent gradient + inset shadow); light mode stays a flat accent tint. tg.js exposes the scheme as data-theme.

title: docs: Cuisine TMA floating-layout MVP mockup (footer carousel + search FAB + floating header)
body: A visual MVP mockup (not built) of the Cuisine TMA reorganized into floating chrome over a full-bleed map: 1) carousel floats at the footer replacing the vertical list; 2) search bar -> a floating FAB that expands to a full search card; 3) floating always-present header; 4) carousel above the search bar. Two states side-by-side + a what-moves-where table. Static doc, no version bump.

title: feat(cuisine): floating always-present header (v0.62.127) - floating-layout step 1
body: Floating-layout step 1 of 4. The header (soleat - Cuisine - flags - weather - region pills) is now a floating, always-present bar: sticky to the top with a frosted backdrop, full-bleed via negative gutter margins. Staged because the footer carousel + search-bar FAB share the footer zone with the FAB cluster and the search-bar FAB means relocating the ~400-line search-criteria block; landing the safe header first.

title: feat(cuisine): dock result carousel at the footer, off the map (v0.62.128)
body: Floating-layout step 2 of the footer rebuild. The music-app carousel now docks at the footer, off the map: rendered at App top level as a fixed layer above the FAB cluster (bottom-16, z-30) so the map stays fully visible behind it (was a MapPanel child overlaying the lower map). The vertical ResultPanel stays below as the scroll-down fallback. Layout/interaction not covered by automated tests - on-device check advised.

title: feat(maps): skeuomorphic map pop-up info card across all TMAs (v0.62.129)
body: The Google-map pop-up card (the InfoWindow tapped open from a pin) is now skeuomorphic, not liquid glass: infoCard() renders a raised, beveled physical card - top-light to bottom-shade gradient, hairline border, soft drop shadow + inset top highlight. Applied identically in cuisine/hawker/transport map overlays; palette-derived via color-mix so it follows infoPalette.

title: feat(cuisine): line-coloured station code chips in the venue pop-up (v0.62.130)
body: In the Cuisine eatery pop-up, the nearest-station codes now ride their official MRT line background colour instead of a plain link. transitBlockHtml's train row renders each code as a white-on-colour chip via the now-exported codeHex (NS red, EW green, CC orange, DT blue, TE brown, NE purple, BP/LRT grey, JR teal, CR lime). Interchanges show one chip per line code. The chip-row stays the tap-to-focus station link.

title: fix(cuisine): rating-toast leak on close + sync package-lock (v0.62.131)
body: 1) Bug: the Rating reset to Good+ >=3.7 footer toast survived in state when the TMA went hidden, flashing into the close and lingering on reopen; the visibilitychange handler now dismisses it (setRatingReminder(null)) the moment the TMA hides. 2) Deploy hygiene: package-lock.json was frozen at 0.62.31 while package.json was at 0.62.131 - synced (a candidate npm ci failure on Railway). Plus a Railway deploy-failure investigation (everything passes locally; suspected prod omit-devDeps -> postinstall can't find vite).

title: feat(maps): default result-map zoom 11 -> 12 across all TMAs (v0.62.132)
body: Default result-map zoom 11 -> 12 across all three map TMAs: cuisine MapPanel init zoom + no-fresh-search recenter -> 12; hawker SG_DEFAULT_ZOOM 11->12; transport SG_DEFAULT_ZOOM 11->12. When results exist the map still fit-bounds to the pins - 12 is the empty/initial framing default. package.json + package-lock.json kept in sync.

title: feat(maps): centre-map (U+21B9) button across all TMAs; drop Google nav pad (v0.62.133)
body: Remove Google's native zoom/pan pad and add a centre map button between + and - in every map. public/app.js (/app/map fullscreen): zoomControl false + a custom +/centre/- control cluster (RIGHT_CENTER); centre recenters on the initial centre. Cuisine/Hawker/Transport TMAs: centre button inserted between + and - in each custom cluster (recenters on searchCenter/anchor for cuisine, SG centroid for hawker/transport).
